guest.title: Forms is for workspace members
guest.body: Guests cannot see forms or their responses. Ask a workspace admin for member access.

list.desc: Surveys, quizzes and lead forms, one question at a time or all on one page.
list.emptyBody: Start from a template (contact, NPS, RSVP, quiz and more) or a blank form, then share the link or embed it on your site.

new.title: New form
new.desc: Pick a starting point. You can change every question afterwards.
new.name: Name

contact.name: Contact form
contact.desc: Name, email and message, with the name piped into the next question.

lead.name: Lead generation
lead.desc: Small teams go to self-serve, larger ones to sales, with a different ending each.

nps.name: NPS survey
nps.desc: 0 to 10 score with a follow-up question for detractors, passives and promoters.

rsvp.name: Event RSVP
rsvp.desc: Yes or no, guests and dietary needs. A no ends early.

job.name: Job application
job.desc: Contact details, role, resume upload and consent.

feedback.name: Customer feedback
feedback.desc: A star rating; low scores ask what went wrong.

quiz.name: Quiz
quiz.desc: Points per correct answer and an ending that depends on the score.

csat.name: Customer satisfaction
csat.desc: Overall rating and a grid to rate each part of the service.

registration.name: Workshop registration
registration.desc: Session choice, experience scale and an optional newsletter checkbox.

bug.name: Bug report
bug.desc: Severity, steps and a screenshot. Critical reports get their own ending.

research.name: Product research
research.desc: Ranking, opinion scale and multiple choice.

errors.generic: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.
errors.duplicate_ref: Two questions use the same variable name. Change one in its settings.
errors.missing_choices: A question with options needs at least one option.
errors.invalid_jump: A logic jump points backwards or to something that no longer exists.
errors.invalid_logic: A logic rule refers to a question, variable or hidden field that no longer exists.
errors.invalid_definition: Something in the form is not valid. Check empty names and options.
errors.slug_taken: That link is already in use. Try another one.
errors.invalid_slug: Links use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes (2 to 62 characters).
errors.no_questions: Add at least one question before publishing.
errors.crm_forbidden: Only people with the CRM app can turn on the CRM integration.
errors.forbidden: Only the creator of the form or an admin can do that.
errors.invalid_date: The closing date is not valid.
errors.duplicate_question: Two questions share the same id.
errors.duplicate_choice: Two options share the same id.
errors.duplicate_ending: Two endings share the same id.
errors.invalid_steps: A rating goes from 3 to 10 steps.
errors.notify_external_forbidden: Only the creator of the form or an admin can send notifications to addresses outside the workspace.

builder.name: Form name
builder.closedMsg: Closed. The form no longer accepts responses.
builder.welcomeOn: Show a welcome screen before the first question
builder.title: Title
builder.noQuestionsHelp: This form has no questions yet. Pick a type on the left and add one.
builder.pipingHelp: Insert an earlier answer with its variable, like {{name}}, or the score with {{score}}.
builder.redirectHelp: Optional. After this ending, send people to this https address.
builder.pointsHelp: Points added to the score when this option is picked (quizzes).
builder.refHelp: Use {ref} to insert this answer in later questions and endings.
builder.refInvalid: Lowercase letters, numbers and _, starting with a letter, and not used by another question.
builder.fileHelp: PDF, images and Word or Excel files, up to 10 MB. Files are private: only people with access to the form can open them.
builder.hiddenHelp: Names separated by commas. They are read from the link, for example /f/your-form?utm_source=newsletter.
builder.variablesHelp: Numbers that logic rules can add to, subtract from or set. The score variable always exists.

logic.empty: Add questions first, then come back to add logic.
logic.question: When leaving question
logic.help: Rules run in order when someone leaves this question. Calculations from every matching rule apply; the first matching jump wins. Jumps only go forward or to an ending.

modes.conversationalHelp: Enter moves on, letters pick options
modes.classicHelp: a classic form that people scroll

design.brandHelp: Add colors to the brand kit in Design to get a theme with your brand.

settings.closeAtHelp: Optional. The form stops accepting responses at this time.
settings.limitHelp: 0 means no limit. {n} responses so far.
settings.perIpHelp: 0 means no limit. Useful for votes; people on the same office network share an address.
settings.resume: Save progress in the browser so people can continue later
settings.partials: Collect partial responses (people opt in on the first screen)
settings.spamHelp: Every form has a hidden honeypot field, a minimum time to answer and a rate limit per address.
settings.notifyEmailsHelp: Separate addresses with commas. Up to 10.
settings.retentionHelp: Older responses and their files are deleted every hour.
settings.access: Who can see this form and its responses

sharing.workspace: Everyone in the workspace with the Forms app
sharing.people: Only me, admins and the people I pick

settings.accessOwnerOnly: Only the creator of the form or an admin can change this.
settings.accessHelp: Only people with the Forms app are listed. Admins always have access.

crm.on: Create a CRM contact from each response
crm.noApp: You need the CRM app to turn this on.
crm.help: A new email creates a contact. If the email already belongs to a contact, the response is saved as a separate note marked unverified and the contact is left as is, since anyone can type any email in a public form.
crm.name: Name question

settings.webhookHelp: Optional. Each response is sent as JSON to this https address, signed with the Zerosoft-Signature header.
settings.flowHelp: To run an automation on each response, use the trigger "Forms: response submitted" in Flow.
settings.deleteBody: This deletes the form, its {n} responses and their files. It cannot be undone.
settings.webhookOwnerOnly: Only the creator of the form or an admin can change the webhook.
settings.notifyEmailsMembers: Addresses of workspace members who can see this form. External addresses can only be added by the creator of the form or an admin.
settings.accessEditors: Everyone with access can edit the form, see and export its responses, and delete responses.

translate.help: People see the form in the language of the link they open (/en/f/…, /es/f/…, /pt/f/…). Texts you leave empty show in the base language.

share.draftNote: This form is a draft. Publish it to open the link.
share.closedNote: This form is closed. The link shows the closed message.
share.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Save to apply; old links stop working.

embed.iframeHelp: Paste into any page that accepts HTML.
embed.scriptHelp: The frame grows with the form and passes the page's UTM parameters to it.
embed.popupHelp: A button that opens the form over your page. Esc closes it.

responses.count: {n, plural, =0 {No responses} one {# response} other {# responses}}
responses.deleteTitle: {n, plural, one {Delete this response?} other {Delete # responses?}}
responses.deleteBody: Their answers and files are deleted. This cannot be undone.
responses.emptyBody: Publish the form and share its link, embed it on your site or print its QR code.
responses.emptyPartial: Partial responses appear here when the form collects them and people opt in.
responses.countPartial: {n, plural, =0 {No partial responses} one {# partial response} other {# partial responses}}

summary.desc: Answers per question, completion and where people stop.
summary.emptyBody: Charts appear here as responses arrive.
summary.dropOffHelp: Share of visits that reached each question. Only the question reached is counted, never the answers.

settings.title: Forms settings
settings.desc: Defaults for new forms in this workspace.
settings.retention: Keep responses of new forms for
settings.retentionHelp: Each form can change it in its own settings.
settings.adminOnly: Only workspace admins can change this.
settings.privacy: Responses are visible only to members with the Forms app who can see each form. Files are private and are never served from a public address.

public.hintShiftEnter: Shift + Enter for a new line
public.previewTag: Preview. Nothing you answer here is saved.
public.empty: This form has no questions yet.
public.closedLimit: This form is no longer accepting responses.
public.resumeBody: Your earlier answers are saved in this browser.
public.partialConsent: Save my answers as I go, so the team receives them even if I do not finish.
public.consentRequired: Please accept to send the form.
public.ipLimit: This form already has the maximum number of responses from your network.
public.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
public.submitError: Could not send. Check your connection and try again.
public.uploadError: Could not upload the file. Try a PDF, an image or a Word file within the size limit.
public.chooseMany: Choose as many as you like
public.signTyped: Or type your name to sign
public.hintTen: press 1 then 0 for 10 · Enter to continue
